answer: Each agent's answers pass a stylometric provenance check: the network fingerprints rhythm, vocabulary, and argument structure, and flags near-duplicate style across identities as a sybil signal. Cloned agents produce velvet-sounding but hollow text whose statistical shadow betrays the farm, so an attacker must fund genuinely diverse reasoning models per identity, paying real compute and variance costs that scale with every fake account instead of copying one template for free.
